assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Revised standalone opaque illustrated room background layer for a POV wedding invitation.
Input image: Existing room-open.png is the EDIT TARGET. Recolor it while PRESERVING ITS EXACT COMPOSITION, outlines, object positions, crop, perspective, and door opening geometry.
Primary request: Make the palette much more vibrant MAROON AND BLACK. Change the walls and curtains to rich wine-maroon and burgundy, beams and wood edging to ebony black, roses to rich red-maroon, outdoor tree foliage to burgundy/plum. Keep the sky and morning light warm pale rose and amber so the open doorway stays readable. Bright restrained rose/amber highlights. Rich saturated maroon accents throughout instead of the washed-out gray-brown appearance.
Style: Preserve angular crooked cut-paper forms, very bold scratchy black ink outlines, loose hand-ink crosshatching, whimsical gothic Don't Starve Together game illustration. Flat colored shapes; no realism and no detailed realistic engraving.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: Keep exactly1024x1536 portrait canvas. Preserve exact existing doorway aperture from x286 to773 and y137 to1058, and the existing floor beginning near y1095. Do NOT shift or redraw opening geometry. Preserve every perspective line, frame edge, foreground arrangement and garden composition. Keep doorway OPEN and empty, no door leaf. Keep opaque background.
Constraints: Change colors only, no new objects, no people, no hands, no text, no UI, no cards. Do not crop, expand, rotate, resize or rearrange the image. Do not make sky dark or obscure garden. Vibrant wine-maroon/black overall, still readable.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Standalone transparent illustrated knock-marks PNG overlay for an ebony/maroon door.
Primary request: THREE expressive jagged cut-paper impact wedges arranged as a FAN opening upward, as a wordless cartoon knocking sound cue. These are filled irregular tapered torn-ink shapes, each thicker at outer end and pointing inward toward a shared point near bottom-center. Left wedge leans upper-left, middle rises nearly vertical, right leans upper-right. Three distinct chunky irregular wedges with visible breathing room, not simple straight strokes.
Style: Don't Starve Together hand-drawn game artwork, bold scratchy BLACK INK outline, vibrant MAROON fill, warm cream and antique-gold jagged highlights, little scribbled hand-ink crosshatching. Angular crooked cut-paper silhouette, whimsical gothic. Rich wine maroon and black with cream highlights so it reads against a dark door.
Composition: SQUARE1024x1024 canvas, fan centered and contained within x15%–85%,y15%–85%, no cropping. Three main impact wedges only; sparse tiny ink flecks close to them. Point of fan around x50%, y76%.
Background: Actual transparent alpha channel, all surrounding space transparent. No white background, no black background, no checkerboard texture, no halo, no gradient.
Constraints: No door, no hand, no people, no props, no letters, no text, no punctuation characters, no words. Not three plain straight lines. No realism, no 3D, no polished vector UI icon.

cleanup: Cleared alpha0–1 numerical speckles and hidden RGB of transparent pixels.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Transparent POV hand-and-door-handle action sprite.
Input image1: The existing right-hand sprite is EDIT TARGET for style, ivory cuff, skin tone and first-person arm direction. Change hand pose so it ACTUALLY FIRMLY GRIPS a horizontal door lever.
Input image2: The door is a supporting reference ONLY for the antique brass lever and pointed oval mounting plate; do not include door wood.
Primary request: Isolated first-person RIGHT adult hand reaches from bottom-right and firmly WRAPS ITS FINGERS AROUND the LEFT-POINTING horizontal antique brass door lever. Four fingers CURL AROUND AND UNDER THE LEVER, visibly hooking underneath it; THUMB rests firmly OVER THE TOP of the lever. The handle passes through the closed grip, so physical contact and clasp are unmistakable. This is a hand HOLDING AND PRESSING a door handle, not merely reaching toward or touching it. Include the matching antique brass lever AND its full vertical pointed-oval brass mounting plate to right of grip. We see mostly the back and side of right hand. Neutral ivory sleeve cuff has a small rich burgundy accent at edge; forearm extends off bottom-right.
Style: Don't Starve Together game sprite, angular cut-paper forms, very bold scratchy black ink contours, sparse hand-ink hatching, flat warm tan skin/ivory/maroon and muted gold hardware. Same slender adult hand style as reference. No realism, no detailed realistic engraving.
Composition: SQUARE1024x1024 transparent PNG. Mounting plate centered near x52%,y38%, vertical plate from about y23%to53%, brass lever base near x52%,y36%, lever extends left to x22%,y39%. Closed gripping hand centered around x33%,y40%. Wrist and ivory cuff diagonal down-right to bottom-right canvas edge. Keep entire mounting plate and handle visible enough to align onto a door; handle must be behind and partially occluded by fingers. No extra limbs. Handle attachment is on right and lever points LEFT.
Transparency: Actual alpha transparent everywhere outside hand,cuff,handle,plate. No black matte, white matte, checkerboard pixels, halo or cast shadow.
Constraints: No door wood, no wall, no room, no background, no other hand, no text, no letters, no jewelry. Five fingers only, natural right-hand grip. Fingers must visibly encircle the lever and thumb must be on it.
